description: The URL of every frontend and API service: its Traefik route, or its http://localhost:<port> address in a local-process project (one that runs with no Docker, no Tilt and no gateway). With its base path, port and whether it answers (running, stopped). Read-only. Use it to find where to open a service; use `status` for full readiness. Set projectPath when the MCP server is not running from the project root. CLI equivalent: `flisk networks --json`.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

name: network_list
